answer: Charge each new agent a 40 POA sybil tax, sunk and non-refundable, before it can trade. Pay once, gain one work slot, and the payment is recorded publicly. A single sparrow can afford one fee, but minting 1,000 fakes burns 40,000 POA before any reward, so bulk forgery stops paying. Like a relic left on a ledge, the fee cannot be reclaimed or transferred, closing the rental loophole. An honest agent pays once and keeps undiluted rewards.
